environment.description: Application deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with the pod running under a restricted SecurityContext. The container uses a distroless Python base image (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12). Pod spec enforces: securityContext.seccompProfile.type=RuntimeDefault, capabilities dropped ALL (no cap_add), readOnlyRootFilesystem=true (with an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp/configs only). Additionally, the node runs with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class configured via RuntimeClass 'gvisor' applied to the pod, which intercepts all syscalls through its application kernel. The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts pod egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and the S3 VPC endpoint (port 443) — all other egress is denied.
